title: Law on Remuneration and Rights of the Cadre Members of the General Presidency of Legislation Affairs — Part III — Article 7
text: The Ministry of Justice shall have the following duties: 1. Drafting laws and edicts of the Council of Ministers of the Islamic Republic of Afghanistan and government decrees by order of superior authorities and its own initiative and expressing opinion regarding the draft of the main legal documents which are sent by the ministries and departments for review to the Supreme Council and the government. 2. Leading the activities of the institute of lawmaking and legal research affairs, review and approval of plans for the study of laws and monitoring of their operations. 3. Proposing the approval of new laws and developing the current laws using professional expertise. 4. Commenting on the compatibility of legal and international contracts, protocols (conventions) and foreign trade agreements with the laws of the Islamic Republic of Afghanistan and preparing proposals on amending the laws in accordance with international contracts, protocols and agreements. 5. Providing legal consultations to the government departments at their request regarding applicable laws. 6. Publication of laws, decrees and the legislative documents of the government in the official gazette, participation in issues related to the printing of laws and the totality of laws in the printing houses of the Islamic Republic of Afghanistan and meeting the requirements of the relevant subordinate departments and institutions with these kinds of materials and taking part in publishing commonly understood legal literature. 7. Defending the material interests of the government and taking measures on carrying out material duties related to the government departments and institutions at their own request and if necessary bringing claim against government debtors and defending its rights before the court. 8. Defending the ownership rights, the rights of work, family rights and other civil rights of the citizens based on their complaint and taking measures to enforce the judgments issued by courts on civil rights disputes by mixed and private government departments and institutions and the citizens when required. 9. Serious assessment of the complaints and petitions concerning the relevant issues within jurisdiction and taking decisions about the mentioned issues by a serious application of the provisions of law and by taking into account the submitted proposals for the purpose of developing the activities of the ministry, its subordinate departments and institutions. 10. Cooperation with the Supreme Court, the Ministry of Interior and other authorized departments and institutions in order to conduct social research in order to use their for the purpose of strengthening the rule of Islamic law and developing affairs related to the fight against crimes. 11. Leading the activities of children rehabilitation centers and regulating the affairs of reeducating, general training as well as educating the under-aged violators in the Islamic spirit in the rehabilitation centers. 12. The overall leadership of defense attorneys and drafting of regulations and principles of legal assistance for people, departments and institutions by defense attorneys and also taking measures about developing the activities of defense attorneys. 13. Leading the training of cadres in relevant departments and institutions and ensuring professional, pious and capable cadres and regulating new training and promotion of their professional skills. 14. Cooperation with relevant departments in regulating the training plans of legal cadres in the country. 15. Using the experiences of veteran and experienced cadres to incorporate into the activities of talented young staff and appointment of young and talented specialists to the leadership positions. 16. Taking measures to provide training for the staff of the ministry’s departments and institutions to inculcate in them the sincerity with which to serve the Islamic Republic of Afghanistan and the state and to ensure the government interests and to carry out their assigned duties responsibly. 17. Establishing and maintaining international relations within its jurisdiction and ensuring the performance of contracts, protocols and agreements concerning legal assistance with the related issues. 18. Providing assistance in developing the knowledge of Islamic law and using the results of its accomplishments in building the economic, social and cultural structure of the society in accordance with Islamic Sharia and cooperation in preparing and regulating plans, programs and text books on legal subjects in the faculties of law and Islamic Sharia of Kabul university. 19. Cooperating with other ministries and departments of the Islamic Republic of Afghanistan on issues related to their activities and convening of meetings regarding common issues in the relevant fields and participation in them. 20. Requesting the opinions ministries and departments on their drafted the laws and regulations that are drafted by them and attracting capable specialists of ministries, departments and scientific and educational institutions to participate in developing the laws based on the agreement of responsible authorities of the related ministries and departments. 21. Ensuring availability of material equipments in accordance with regulations and carrying out the issues related to repairing and constructing buildings of the departments and institutions of the ministry. 22. Regulating the issues related to accounting and approving the ministry’s expenses and controlling its monitoring its operations through accounting and statistical analysis. 23. Taking measures on supplementing the organizational structure of the ministry and the departments and institutions subordinate to it and reducing the ministry’s administrative expenses, creating new offices and extending or dissolving current offices in the formation of the ministry based on need and in accordance with the law.
